component: Calendar channel principal and auth separation

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Fresh full two-file principal/name change read. The landing substitutes system principal in new calendar channels and decodes the ICS path before choosing a default name. Later available Bug/review discussion explicitly agrees to back out most of the principal change after same-domain/different-auth regressions, withdraws ESR intent and continues elsewhere. Original acceptance/Nextcloud smoke reports are not current policy. Fixed prepHttpChannel again creates a content principal with originAttributes and per-user container separation, with optional fresh-auth context and existing-channel reuse. Fixed ICS handleCalendar retains decodeURI naming. This independently distinguishes the reverted mechanism from the retained remainder. Related reverting source/review and Gecko ORB internals were not independently opened. No Calendar server, auth-isolation, URL or network test ran; no global principal rule is inferred.
title: The Calendar system-principal workaround was withdrawn while ICS name decoding remained
